roadmap.title: Story chapters and Trineangle collection
roadmap.description: Play the story chapters from The Three Heroes through A Beast in the Trees, collecting every Trineangle in each level. Chapter completion and the per-chapter collection achievements unlock along the way, and the Trineangles you gather also unlock the Lost Pages.

roadmap.title: Lost Pages
roadmap.description: Clear the six puzzle Lost Pages and survive the four combat Lost Pages, collecting their Trineangles as you go. Also clear The Quest for Cake, whose 50 Trineangles are required for the all-collection achievement.

roadmap.title: Collection cleanup and platinum
roadmap.description: Collect any Trineangles still missing from the story chapters and Lost Pages, then earn the final achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "The Three Heroes - Pontius"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter The Three Heroes - Pontius.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Three Heroes - Pontius} from the start to the exit and clear the goblin ambush that ends the chapter.

achievements.displayName: But It Belongs in a Museum!
achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "The Three Heroes - Zoya"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter The Three Heroes - Zoya.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Three Heroes - Zoya} to the exit, opening the roped door at the end to take the gemstone.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "The Three Heroes - Amadeus"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter The Three Heroes - Amadeus.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Three Heroes - Amadeus} to the exit, solving the skull door and the two-elevator room at the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter "Academy Outskirts"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter Academy Outskirts.

steps.text: Play @loc{Academy Outskirts} to the exit, defeating the stone golem blocking the route and crossing the three movable platforms at the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "The Astral Academy"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter The Astral Academy.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Astral Academy} to the exit, lighting the button puzzle and defeating the two wizards in the final hall.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "The Chronicles of the Guardian"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter The Chronicles of the Guardian.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Chronicles of the Guardian} through all eight pages to the exit at the end of the book.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "The Redwood Forest"
achievements.summary: Complete the story chapter The Redwood Forest.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Redwood Forest} to the exit, raising the final gate and crossing the last bridge.

achievements.description: Beat the final boss
achievements.summary: Defeat the giant beast boss in the final chapter A Beast in the Trees.

guide.context: The beast hits harder and adds more hazards as its health drops, so keep moving between throws.

steps.text: Lift or charge the fiery metal balls on the ground into the @enemy{beast} to damage it.
When the beast hides a fiery ball inside a robot, break the ice at the robot's base to free the ball and hit the beast with it.
Land 14 fiery-ball hits to kill the beast.
steps.note: Avoid the plant shockwaves, the beast's breath, and the smaller creatures it spawns.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "A Forgotten Parchment"
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Page A Forgotten Parchment.

steps.text: Grapple the moving platform to the left hook, then shoot its rope free to slide down and swing right on the next hook.
Pull the cart by its rope onto the circle, turn it 90 degrees, and push it to the right.
Hook the cage so a box flips onto the cart, then pull the cart back and drop the box onto the button to open the door.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "A Brush with Death"
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Page A Brush with Death.

steps.text: Drop right onto the lowering platform, then jump to the wall and back under it to grapple the hook and swing right.
Hook the roof platform, pull the bridge out, and attach the platform to the bridge about halfway up to climb to the big Trineangle.
Pull the platform all the way down and attach it to the bridge to hold the gate open, then shoot the button to finish.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "A Wizard's Nightmare"
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Page A Wizard's Nightmare.

guide.context: Amadeus can only solve this dream by conjuring boxes; the smashing head and moving platforms do the rest.

steps.text: Slam the rope-held platform down, then ride its bounce to reach the far Trineangle.
Use a box to turn the platforms clockwise and ride them to the right.
Lower the robot's flaming ball, grab it, and smash it into the right wall to open the path north.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "A Wizard's Epiphany"
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Page A Wizard's Epiphany.

steps.text: Drop a block onto the right platform so it lifts you, then shift the block to the left platform to rise again and use the smashing head to reach the Trineangles.
Weight the back of each see-saw platform with a block to cross, and clear the wizard and the evil books.
Drag the log across the mechanism, then set a block under it to lift the log while you stand on it, and stack blocks into a staircase to grab the final Trineangle at the top.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "A Tumble Down"
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Page A Tumble Down.

steps.text: Charge the cart so a box drops onto it, then climb the cart, the box, and the ledge on the right.
Cross to the central rock island and kill the creatures, including the one holding the right door shut.
Stop the high tracks, charge the cart up the wall onto them, then ride it past the rock wall and follow the revolving platforms to the exit.

achievements.description: Complete the Chapter: "A Lonely Knight"
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Page A Lonely Knight.

steps.text: Float right, scale the wall, and pull yourself onto the top of the big gate, then cross the revolving fans.
Kill the creatures and charge the lever to start the last fan, then cross to the next section.
Stomp the rock pile ahead of the cart to break it and send the cart rolling, then charge the cart back to the left and stomp so it clears the right rails and reaches the exit.

achievements.description: Survive through the Chapter: "A Squabble in the Jungle"
achievements.summary: Survive the combat Lost Page A Squabble in the Jungle.

guide.context: This is a wave fight for Pontius, not a puzzle. All 25 Trineangles drop at once when the arena is cleared, and you must collect them to finish the level.

steps.text: Kill the creatures outside the gateway, charging the two boulders into them.
Go through the gateway and clear the second wave of creatures and larger brutes.
Pick up the 25 Trineangles that drop after the level is cleared.

achievements.description: Survive through the Chapter: "An Academic Invasion"
achievements.summary: Survive the combat Lost Page An Academic Invasion.

guide.context: Amadeus fights the metallic creatures indirectly by crushing them with conjured blocks.

steps.text: Stand on the left ball to start spawning the metallic creatures.
Crush the creatures with Amadeus's conjured blocks.
Use the ball again and kill every creature to end the chapter.

achievements.description: Survive through the Chapter: "A Dangerous Outing"
achievements.summary: Survive the combat Lost Page A Dangerous Outing.

guide.context: Two enemy groups, one on the ground and one in the air, must both be cleared.

steps.text: Defeat the creatures on the ground first.
Ride the stone head upward and use jumping attacks to kill the flying creatures.

achievements.description: Survive through the Chapter: "A Whisper of Evil"
achievements.summary: Survive the combat Lost Page A Whisper of Evil.

guide.context: Pontius fights in an arena and must clear two rounds of creatures; the larger enemies can kill him in about two hits.

steps.text: Charge into the creatures, land three or four normal attacks, then charge again to stay out of reach of the larger enemies.
Clear both rounds of creatures to finish the chapter, which awards 25 Trineangles.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "The Three Heroes - Pontius"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter The Three Heroes - Pontius.

guide.context: Each story chapter hides a fixed set of golden Trineangles. The chapter-select screen tracks your count for the level, so any you miss can be picked up on a replay.

steps.text: Break the vines and the crates under the ramp near the start, then charge the giant watermelon to climb the wall.
Break the north wall with a charged rock, and deflect a fireball into the wall just north of the fireball room, to reach the Trineangles behind each.
Float over the gap, ride the swing, and check the cave to the north for several Trineangles.
Break the crate under the walkway and climb it, then finish the chapter after the goblin ambush.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "The Three Heroes - Zoya"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter The Three Heroes - Zoya.

guide.context: The chapter-select screen tracks this chapter's Trineangles separately, and a replay can recover any you miss.

steps.text: Jump the opening rock ledges for Trineangles and shoot the red fruit to make another fall.
Past the button gate, shoot two more red fruits, climb the wooden structure, and open the skull by jumping to the pole at its top.
Swing to the big Trineangle on the right ledge, then swing through the archways and collect as you go.
At the end of the platforms, drop into the dark cave for extra Trineangles and use its pressure plate to leave.
Complete the moving-ledge and rope-door puzzle to end the chapter.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "The Three Heroes - Amadeus"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter The Three Heroes - Amadeus.

guide.context: Amadeus has no fireball in this chapter, but his conjured boxes solve every obstacle. The chapter-select screen shows the level's remaining Trineangles.

steps.text: Move the starting boxes to jump onto the balcony for a Trineangle, and bump the fruit tree to knock one loose below.
Ride the platform lift up to the ridge, smash a box through the hatch, break the boxes below, then check the shipwreck deck and cabin.
Head left along the deck for extra Trineangles, then cross the rapids with a box and climb out of the canyon.
Lower the bridge to cross, then raise it again to grab the large Trineangle.
Weigh both pressure pads to open the skull door, clear the right bridge, and check both elevators before exiting.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "Academy Outskirts"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter Academy Outskirts.

guide.context: The chapter-select screen tracks this chapter's Trineangles, and the level can be replayed for anything missed.

steps.text: Grapple over the spike pit, smash the crates beneath the ramp, and lower the stuck bridge with an arrow or a charged box.
Open the gate with the two levers, then enter the pond room, hurl the metal ball at the right-hand wall, and dive into the far-wall tunnel for a cave holding 7 Trineangles.
Pull out the floating platform, smash a box onto the lever, climb the wall, and weigh the two horns to open the alcove behind the spike pit.
Cross the spike pit and topple the windmill, then beat the stone golem and clear the building and the wall behind the movable wall.
Rope the fishing line, ride the two wheels, pull down the vine platform, and break the wall near the gazebo with a deflected fireball for the large Trineangle.
Before placing the final three platforms, bring the highest one to the left and jump on it for a large Trineangle, then set them low to high and cross.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "The Astral Academy"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter The Astral Academy.

guide.context: The chapter-select screen tracks this chapter's Trineangles, so any missed ones can be found by replaying the level.

steps.text: Cross the bridge, ride the water elevator, and grab the Trineangles through the arch before dropping to the balcony.
Build the box staircase, break the vines, swing for the Trineangles, and hook the platform to reach the big Trineangle.
Step a box onto the purple mirror to rise, then drop the log to lift the next platform and check the hidden alcove below.
Break the left wall with a boulder for a Trineangle, stomp the springboard to float across, and swing under the bridge for the left-hand one.
Stop the revolving blades with a box to reach a Trineangle, then continue on to the water elevator.
On the outer walls, shoot the cage rope for the big Trineangle and grapple the hook by the second elevator for another.
Let the rolling flaming balls smash the next wall open for Trineangles, then ride the purple-mirror boxes inside and check to the left and behind the statue.
Cut the rope so the block falls and reveals one more Trineangle, then scale the right wall and float across to the final big Trineangle.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "The Chronicles of the Guardian"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter The Chronicles of the Guardian.

guide.context: The book splits the chapter into eight pages, and the chapter-select screen tracks the level's Trineangles so a replay can recover misses.

steps.text: On page 1, use the hovering block to reach the right ledge, then lift it and jump to the big Trineangle above.
On page 2, arrange the two hovering blocks to jump left for the big Trineangle, then cross the bouncy pillars.
On page 3, build a hovering-block staircase through the window and shoot the rope through the center gap to drop the staircase platform.
On page 4, ride the falling stone head to jump left for the big Trineangle, and stomp the wooden platform for a hidden left alcove.
On page 5, rope the flap to the hovering block to open it for Trineangles, then bring the two ramps together with the block.
On page 6, crash the stone head next to the rocks to shake Trineangles loose, then stomp the bouncy bed and jump left for more.
On page 7, bounce up-left for a Trineangle, press both pillar buttons for the central big one, and bring the bouncy bed to the ledges.
On page 8, grapple up for the Trineangles above and grab the big Trineangle at the top left before the final room.

achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from the Chapter: "The Redwood Forest"
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the chapter The Redwood Forest.

guide.context: The chapter-select screen tracks this chapter's Trineangles and the level is replayable, so no Trineangle is permanently lost.

steps.text: Cross the tipping log and beams, topple the rock pillar, then pull the wooden box down and jump to the platform for a Trineangle.
Swim to the right, charge the rock wall for a Trineangle, follow the deer, then double back to climb the tree ledges.
Shoot the rope to drop the rock, raise yourself with the box platform, unfold the bridge, and roll a metal ball into the fire basket.
Repeat at the ball chute to open the gate, hook the gate open, and grab the Trineangles along the next path.
Swing up the tree to the three pull-out hooks, cross the large wooden platforms, and pull out the rock on the branch.
In the ice section, free the lever and send the balls to the fire basket, then rope the two bridge platforms down to cross.
Spin the rock wheel and ride it to the right, then rope the branch rock to the pole and float down for the big Trineangle.
At the last checkpoint, clear the creatures and break the ice on both sides of the gate top to raise it.

achievements.displayName: All Your Collectible Are Belong to Me
achievements.description: Collect each Trineangle from every Chapter
achievements.summary: Collect every Trineangle in the game, including the Lost Page The Quest for Cake.

guide.context: This unlocks only after both the story chapters and every Lost Page, including @loc{The Quest for Cake}, have had their Trineangles collected.

steps.text: Collect every Trineangle in Academy Outskirts, The Astral Academy, and The Chronicles of the Guardian, plus the three Three Heroes chapters and The Redwood Forest.
Collect every Trineangle in each Lost Page, including @loc{The Quest for Cake}, where the illusory cake at the end hides the last big Trineangle.
Check the level-select Trineangle counter for each level and replay any level that is still short.
If the achievement does not appear after every counter is complete, replay the final section of @loc{The Quest for Cake} and collect the cake again.

achievements.description: Complete all of the main story Chapters
achievements.summary: Complete every main-story chapter, from The Three Heroes to A Beast in the Trees.

steps.text: Finish all three The Three Heroes chapters, then The Astral Academy, Academy Outskirts, The Redwood Forest, and The Chronicles of the Guardian.
Finish the final chapter A Beast in the Trees by killing the giant beast.

achievements.description: Earn every Achievement in Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power.

steps.text: Earn the other 27 achievements; Icing the Cake unlocks once the final one is complete.
If it does not appear immediately, restart the game to trigger it.
